x: Eventually England agreed to compete providing, of course, that the race was postponed a week to enable the great Alfred Shrubb to run! Shrubb duly won and England's scoring 6 were split only by the Irishman Daly, who was 3rd.

He looks like a shire horse but goes like Nijinsky - he can discourse on Alfred Shrubb, Yuri Gagarin, Grandma Moses, Christine Keeler or Socrates, usually does, and probably at 49 miles in a 54 mile race.
C: I personally have known you to masquerade as a runner but contemporaries of Alf Shrubb have suggested that you are a failed walker too, can you comment?

Well done to the Beagles who took the team title for the first time since 1901 - when Alf Shrubb was individual winner. Commiserations to Bedford & County who came so close ... and to Leeds City who after three years at the top, slipped to third.
